name: India: 140-series promotional calls (TRAI)
description: Warns about calls from the 140 series, which TRAI requires for promotional (telemarketing) voice calls. The 1600 series used for banking and government service calls is never touched.
author: Parley

sources.title: TRAI Press Release No. 11/2025 (140 series for promotional calls, 1600 series for service calls)
TRAI Press Release No. 91/2026 (clarification on the 140 and 1600 series)

notes: TRAI's rules say networks and apps must not tag or filter 140-series calls on their own. This template is a choice you make on your own phone, and it only warns. The official way to stop these calls is the Do Not Disturb registry (dial or text 1909).
